outcome: Duration of pregnancy from intervention to delivery
cohort: 120 low-risk pregnant women with singleton pregnancies between 38-40 weeks of gestation and no medical or obstetric complications.
finding: Membrane sweeping significantly reduced the duration of pregnancy and increased the incidence of spontaneous labour in low-risk cases.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in the mode of delivery between the membrane sweeping and control groups.
followup_time: Until delivery and immediate postpartum for neonatal outcomes
